about: Where each part of @origingame/engine-knowledge lands in the platform's production tree: skills as game/skills/<name>/, looks/ and presets/ beside og-taste, guides/ beside og-game. One scaffold overlay per profile, not per view: origin-engine-ts is 3d; origin-engine-ts-2d is 2d. side-2d and top-down-2d select 2d; isometric-2.5d, third-person-3d and first-person-3d select 3d. Apply the create block's per-view camera and controls on top of that overlay through create-game's applyCreationChoices. The generated API wiki is not mounted: og api reads engine/knowledge/wiki. @template/ and @template-2d/ are templates/game and templates/game-2d in the repository, scaffold/template/ and scaffold/template-2d/ (text files copied at prepack) in the published package.
